requests.submitted_prompt_exact:
8-second photoreal live-action shot, same woman, clothes, phone, outdoor yard, table, gray folder, drawings and glass as the starting frame. Camera remains locked at this high three-quarter angle; no sky enters the composition.
She holds the same thin black smartphone at her left ear and calmly says once in natural Korean: "결과 말고, 어떻게 했는지도요." Start after a short 0.3-second pause and finish naturally by about 3 seconds. Clear conversational Korean female voice, not theatrical.
As she finishes speaking, a large rectangular office module passing overhead OUTSIDE the frame casts a realistic soft-edged shadow. Its shadow enters the distant concrete ground, travels toward the table, then crosses the table surface, papers and her clothing. This is an actual cast shadow attached to physical surfaces: the edge bends and changes perspective at each surface, and visible texture remains inside the shadow. Keep daylight outside the shadow unchanged. Do not use a black screen overlay, wipe, fade, lighting transition or flat opaque shape. Do not show the module itself in this shot.
She stops speaking, notices the shade, and lifts her eyes and chin toward the overhead source by about 5 seconds, then holds that curious upward look. Her phone and right hand remain stable; no extra objects or gestures.
Exactly one woman, two hands and one smartphone, no telephone cable. No other dialogue, narrator, music, subtitles or captions. Quiet outdoor ambience and a faint distant machinery sound only.

requests.submitted_prompt_exact:
8-second photoreal live-action shot from the exact starting image. Same Korean woman, black ponytail, beige blouse, teal vest, orange-framed workspace, desk and closed orange folder. Camera locked.
The object at her LEFT ear is one thin flat rectangular black SMARTPHONE with camera lenses and a flat back. Preserve that exact smartphone shape for the entire shot. It has no cable, cord, curved handset, base or receiver. Her RIGHT hand rests lightly on the closed orange folder, which stays flat on the desk throughout.
After a half-second pause, she asks once in clear natural Korean, mildly puzzled: "이건 왜 보냈어요?" Finish the question naturally within the first three seconds. Her visible mouth moves naturally with the words. Normal conversational adult Korean female voice, not robotic and not rushed.
After the question she closes her mouth and listens silently, lowering her eyes slightly toward the folder without turning her body or head away. No file pickup, page opening, phone transfer or new prop. The other caller does not speak in this generation.
Exactly two hands and one smartphone throughout. No cable or second phone. No additional words, narrator, music, subtitles or captions. Quiet room tone only. Preserve the architecture, sunlight and clothing.

8-second realistic live-action shot. Keep the woman, clothes, room and objects exactly as in the first image. Fixed camera. Her left hand holds the same thin flat black smartphone against her left ear. Her right hand stays on the closed orange folder on the desk. One smartphone, two hands; keep the phone cordless with no cable and no extra objects.
She asks in a natural clear Korean female voice: "이건 왜 보냈어요?" She says this one short question near the beginning, then listens calmly with her mouth closed. Small natural facial motion only. Keep her body facing the desk and the folder flat on the desk. Quiet room ambience. No music or captions.
